defect: The fix adds an overReadSafe flag (and a valid-address check) so the sampler JIT avoids gathers that could read past the end of VRAM; it also drops hasStandardMips.
reason: ComputeSamplerID/DescribeSamplerID were moved verbatim from Sampler.cpp in this refactor, so the missing overread check predates the change.

defect: The fix replaces the hasStandardMips bit with an overReadSafe bit so the sampler JIT can skip gathers that might read past valid memory.
reason: The overread risk comes from the VPGATHERDD lookups added later (22f770c and successors); the ID bits added here were not wrong, only repurposed.

defect: Jit_ReadQuad uses VPGATHERDD to load a full 32-bit dword at each CLUT4 texel's byte offset, so a texture placed at the very end of VRAM is overread and can segfault.
reason: The gather path that the fix gates with id.overReadSafe was added by this change, and its 4-byte read for a 4-bit texel is visible in the diff.

defect: The new scePsmfQueryStreamOffset stub writes a fake offset of 0 and returns 0, which leaves Saint Seiya Omega's history mode on a black screen.
reason: Before this change the syscall was unimplemented and left v0 untouched, so the game-breaking stub behaviour that the fix works around (returning 1) was added here; that it breaks a game is only observable at runtime.

defect: The fix default-initializes FrameData's Vulkan handles to VK_NULL_HANDLE and profilingEnabled_ to false.
reason: These members were already uninitialized in VulkanRenderManager's nested FrameData; this change moved the struct verbatim into a new header.

defect: The rewritten bitwise color test computes colorTestRef as roundAndScaleTo8x4(u_alphacolorref.rgb), multiplying an already 0..255 reference by 255 again, so the comparison against the masked fragment color is wrong.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added line with packFloatsTo8x4, and the removed lines in the same diff show u_alphacolorref being used unscaled as 0..255 values.

defect: The new SnapGrid::Draw draws its lines with vLine/hLine while the UI context is in textured mode, so the grid lines render incorrectly (and the grid is added on top of the controls).
reason: The fix wraps exactly this new drawing code in BeginNoTex/Flush/Begin, which is only needed once you know the DrawBuffer line helpers require untextured mode.

defect: The fix changes the savegame_dir/assets_dir string-literal pointers from char* to const char* to silence const-conversion warnings.
reason: This is warning cleanup, not a functional defect, and the new assets_dir lines just copy the pre-existing char* savegame_dir pattern.

defect: The combined FPS/speed display divides vps by the integer iDisplayRefreshRate (60) instead of the PSP's 59.94 Hz, so full speed shows as about 99.9%.
reason: The fix corrects exactly this changed line by subtracting 0.06, and the diff shows 59.94f being replaced by an integer setting while the sibling branch keeps 59.94f.

defect: The new matchingSize expression is mis-parenthesized, so the height check binds only to the 480/512 case and depth is blitted between buffers of equal width but different height.
reason: The fix regroups exactly this added line, and the operator-precedence error (dropping the old height requirement) is readable in the diff.

defect: The fix changes the default disabled item/button background colour from 0x55E0D4AF to 0x55000000 (alongside a View.cpp change to how disabled choices are drawn).
reason: 0x55E0D4AF was already the default in Config.cpp before this change, so the new Theme.cpp only carried it over; the fix is a visual design adjustment.

defect: The fix makes _assert_ on Android call AndroidAssertLog directly so failed asserts actually abort with a message in the crash dump.
reason: Before this change _assert_ expanded to _dbg_assert_, which was already a no-op in Android release builds, so the non-firing assert predates the change; the fix extends the change's Android assert feature to _assert_ rather than repairing a regression.

defect: The fix renames the misnamed handler sceUtilityGetSystemParamInt_ to sceUtilitySetSystemParamInt and updates its table entry.
reason: The handler was already bound to the correct NID and table name, so the fix is a pure rename with no behavioural change.

defect: For a full icache clear, InvalidateCacheAt skips InvalidateBlock on each block and calls ClearAllBlocks instead, so blocks are not marked invalid and the RISC-V JIT crashes when execution returns into a cleared block.
reason: The fix removes exactly the special case this change added; seeing why it crashes needs the backend's InvalidateBlock/ClearAllBlocks semantics.

defect: The fix moves CreateDirect's initial layout transition so it is recorded after vkBindImageMemory instead of before.
reason: The transition was already issued before memory binding prior to this change; the change only swapped TransitionImageLayout for TransitionImageLayout2 at the same spot.

defect: After halving msg to MAX_MSGLEN, the new code advances msgPos by vsnprintf's would-be length and then writes '\n' and '\0' at msgPos, so any truncated long message writes past the end of the stack buffer.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added lines with truncation-aware handling; the old code had the same return-value arithmetic but a buffer twice as large, so this change made the overflow reachable for messages that used to fit.

defect: The fix replaces the WrapI_CUIU wrapper with WrapV_CUIU because sceKernelCreateMutex was rewritten to return void, set its own result and reschedule.
reason: WrapI_CUIU itself was correct; the wrapper swap only follows the fix's redesign of sceKernelCreateMutex's validation and scheduling, whose real defects are in sceKernelMutex.cpp.

defect: The fix corrects the hand-written NEON asm hash (cursor2's upper half loaded into d2 instead of d3) and re-enables it by flipping #if 1 back to #if 0.
reason: The vmov d2/d3 bug was in pre-existing asm; this change only toggled the preprocessor switch to the intrinsics path, which the fix reverts after repairing the asm.

defect: In this file the fix only rewrites ShutdownInstanceCounter's NULL checks as a truthiness test and nullptr; the actual restart fix calls ShutdownInstanceCounter from GameSettingsScreen.cpp.
reason: The Instance.cpp edit is purely stylistic and the behavioural fix lives in another file's restart path, not in lines this change added.

defect: The fix corrects SetBlendModePSP's FIXA/FIXB and abs-diff blend table entries, and incidentally adds GL_STENCIL_BUFFER_BIT to the no-FBO clear in CopyDisplayToOutput.
reason: The blend lookup tables predate this change, and the only touched line from this change (the black-screen glClear without stencil) is cosmetic, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix changes int loop counters to size_t to silence signed/unsigned comparison warnings.
reason: This is warning cleanup with no behavioural effect, and one of the loops (in GetCodesList) predates this change.

defect: In this file the fix calls CheckGLExtensions before T3DCreateGLContext, unconditionally, instead of after it; the rest of the fix adds the call to the other platforms' startup code.
reason: On Windows the create-then-check order was copied unchanged from NativeInitGraphics, so it was not new; the real regression (other platforms losing the call) lies in other files.

defect: The fix replaces hash::Fletcher with hash::Adler32 for the text cache keys, because Fletcher works two bytes at a time and collides on short strings.
reason: DrawString already hashed the string with Fletcher before this change; the change only fed it the normalized text instead of the raw pointer.

defect: The fix replaces hash::Fletcher with hash::Adler32 for the Qt text cache key, because Fletcher collides on short strings.
reason: The Qt drawer, including its Fletcher hashing, was moved verbatim from draw_text_win.cpp, so the weak hash predates this change.

defect: The fix redesigns branch-line drawing: it gets lines from DisassemblyManager and positions them by a per-row address map, replacing the old (by then commented-out) function/stray-line loops.
reason: This change only switched loop counters from int to size_t to silence warnings; the fix deletes those loops as part of a rework for variable-size disassembly lines, not to repair them.

defect: The fix removes the visibleFunctionAddresses/strayLines members, empties clearFunctions and changes drawBranchLine's signature for the new DisassemblyManager-based branch lines.
reason: The fix is a redesign of how branch lines are computed; the clearFunctions clearing and gotoAddr rescan added here were not themselves faulty.

defect: The fix replaces the remaining threadReadyQueue[priority] expressions with the queue reference that a later commit introduced.
reason: queue is a reference to threadReadyQueue[priority], so the 'typo' fix is purely cosmetic; the rotation logic this change added behaves the same before and after.

defect: The new VLDR/VSTR offset assertion masks with 0xC003 instead of 0xC03, so out-of-range offsets (1024 and up) pass and corrupt the encoding, and the change also adds an ERROR_LOG on every emitted VLDR/VSTR.
reason: The fix corrects exactly these added lines, and the mismatch with the 0xC03 mask in the very next added if-statement is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix implements lwc1/swc1 in Comp_FPULS properly (add the memory base, handle immediate addresses, enable swc1) and comments out the leftover logBlocks = 1 debug switch in Comp_FPU2op.
reason: The broken FPULS load/store code predates this change and was still disabled; the only touched line from this change is a debug-logging toggle, not a functional defect.

defect: In Config.cpp the fix only rewrites ResetLayout's reset lambda to take a pointer (adding a comment that show is untouched) and downgrades two config-load log messages to warnings; the visibility fix itself is a new TouchControlConfig constructor in Config.h.
reason: The Config.cpp edits are behaviour-neutral; the wrong default button visibility is repaired in Config.h, not in lines this change added to this file.

defect: The new Windows path normalization calls ReplaceAll(e.s, "//", "/") instead of replacing backslashes, so paths keep their backslashes and duplicate recents are not eliminated.
reason: The fix changes exactly these two added lines to "\\"; the mismatch with the commit's stated intent (replace backslashes with forward slashes) is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix restructures OnEnableAll so the checkbox array is set to enableAll once after the loop, rather than only inside branches that find a cheat line in the opposite state.
reason: This change only replaced the literal 64 with sizeof(enableCheat), which is also 64 for bool[64]; the faulty enable/disable-all logic predates it.

defect: The fix skips the host memmove in Replace_memcpy when destPtr is 0, avoiding a crash on a null destination.
reason: Before this change Replace_memcpy already did the unchecked memmove whenever bytes != 0, so the null-destination crash predates the change; the change only moved the VRAM update ahead of the copy.

defect: The fix makes RetroAchievementsListScreen keep its rc_client achievement list in a member and free it in a new destructor, plugging a leak.
reason: This change only renamed the base class; the leaked achievement list is created in the screen's .cpp code, which the rename did not touch.

defect: The new themable Slider::Draw picks the 'pressed' colour from down_, which Clickable clears whenever the finger leaves the bounds mid-drag, so the slider's line, knob and value revert to the normal colour while it is still being dragged.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added down_ test with dragging_; seeing why needs Clickable::Touch's semantics for down_ versus dragging_.

defect: The change dropped the 1.0 weight from the top bar's path TextView (WRAP_CONTENT) and put it on a new Spacer, so the path no longer takes and is limited to the free width, and the top bar's layout breaks (e.g. a long path crowds out the Browse/layout buttons).
reason: The fix restores the 1.0 weight on the path TextView and removes the spacer this change added; the effect depends on LinearLayout weight semantics, and the issue is a minor visual layout defect.

defect: The fix deletes the new SmartCFile helper and has the shader cache reader use the existing File::IOFile with checked ReadArray calls instead.
reason: Removing SmartCFile is a switch to an existing abstraction; the fix targets unchecked reads in ShaderManager.cpp, not a demonstrated fault in this class.

defect: LoadAndPrecompile ignores fread's result for the shader IDs, so a truncated cache compiles shaders from uninitialized IDs, and it uses vsCache_[vsid]/fsCache_[fsid], which insert null entries for unknown IDs that are then dereferenced via vs->UseHWTransform().
reason: The fix adds truncation checks and find()-based lookups to exactly these added lines, and both the unchecked reads and the operator[] null dereference are readable in the diff.

defect: In this file the fix only adds the channel count to the INFO_LOG added by this change and an outputChannels assert; the mono-initialization typo it repairs lies elsewhere.
reason: The lines this change added are logging and const qualifiers; the fix extends a log message rather than repairing faulty logic here.

defect: The new trigCallHelper lambda passes &sinCosFunc (the address of its local function-pointer parameter) instead of sinCosFunc, so the JIT emits a call into the stack rather than to SinOnly/CosOnly/ASinScaled/NegSinOnly.
reason: The fix removes the stray & in exactly these added lines; the copy-paste error (the original code took &SinOnly of a function) is readable in the diff.
